text: How God the Father sent God the Son, Jesus the Christ, here for you. It's the best example. See, God, because he's holy, has righteous anger against sin. Because sin dishonors him and evil hurts people, image bearers, people he created in his image. He's angered at sin. He's angered at injustices. God hates sin, but he loves people. So what did God do to address his anger?
